segments.text: If you go for a 20-minute walk in the morning on an empty stomach, the following happens.
Since your glycogen stores are depleted overnight, your body switches to burning fat more quickly.
Additionally, your metabolism gets activated, helping you burn fat more efficiently,
which makes weight loss easier and faster. Your cortisol level, the stress hormone,
gets regulated. This helps you feel more relaxed and calm throughout the day.
You may even notice an improved mood, as morning movement boosts the production
of your feel-good hormones like serotonin. After just one week, your circulation improves.
This helps regulate blood pressure and strengthens your cardiovascular system.
Your brain also gets more oxygen, enhancing concentration and mental clarity.
After 20 days, your immune system becomes stronger. Your sleep also improves.
You fall asleep faster and wake up feeling more refreshed.
